image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) lying on dark, wet sand mixed with shell fragments. The crab is oriented vertically with its head at the top. The carapace is broad and oval, exhibiting a mottled pattern of beige, tan, and reddish-brown hues. The ventral side (underside) is partially visible due to the angle, showing cream-colored segments. Two large, robust claws (chelipeds) are prominent in the foreground, with dark tips and serrated inner edges. Multiple walking legs extend laterally from the body. The exoskeleton appears hard and textured, with some sand adhering to the surface.
